summary: Kingsoft Cloud Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a Hong Kong Monthly Return (FF301) for July 2026, reporting no movements in authorized or issued share capital and no share option activity during the month. The filing includes a board meeting date announcement and confirms public float compliance as of month-end. This is a routine regulatory disclosure, not a special situation event. No strategic transactions, capital structure changes, or management events are present; the filing merely satisfies ongoing listing obligations.
